headlines.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
headlines.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots regurgitating that work to users. An overly black-and-white ruling, it says, could either deprive Wikipedians…

concept.title: AI Agents
concept.body: An agent is a model given tools and a goal, allowed to take multiple steps on its own — searching, calling systems, and acting. Power rises, but so does the need for guardrails and oversight.
concept.takeaway: Deploy agents on bounded, reversible tasks first; require approval before anything costly or irreversible.
